title: Birdsville Courthouse

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation between the east courtroom and its approach on Adelaide Street.

mapIdentity.scope: Named OpenStreetMap way 1026090385, tagged with Birdsville Courthouse and Wikidata Q28035357, identifies the articulated roof over the standing building near Adelaide and Macdonald Streets. This outline controls the location and orientation of the original court and attached residence.

note: The archive photograph depicts the prominent corrugated roof, sandstone masonry, a projecting gable, shaded verandah posts and chimney. Written field documentation describes the eastern courtroom’s hipped roof, the residence and veranda enclosures, and the courthouse masonry. Dated council condition material records limewash, a southern gable and chimney. Texture and non-visible details are estimated.
